name: actiongate
description: x402 + Stripe payment proxy for REST APIs and MCP tools. Pre-execution safety layer for autonomous agent wallets with risk scoring, transaction simulation, and policy enforcement.

tools.name: risk_score
tools.description: Score the risk of a proposed agent action before execution. Evaluates actor, action type, and context to return a numeric risk score with explanatory factors.

actor.description: Actor metadata for the agent proposing the action.

actor_id.description: Stable actor identifier for the agent or wallet operator.

wallet_address.description: Optional onchain wallet address associated with the acting agent.

action_type.description: The proposed action category, such as transfer, swap, or approve.

context.description: Optional execution context such as chain state, balances, or treasury metadata.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Estimate cost, failure risk, and notable side effects for a proposed action. Returns estimated gas, failure probability, and warnings.

actor.description: Actor metadata for the agent proposing the action.

actor_id.description: Stable actor identifier for the agent or wallet operator.

wallet_address.description: Optional onchain wallet address associated with the acting agent.

action_type.description: The proposed action category, such as transfer, swap, or approve.

context.description: Optional execution context such as chain state, balances, or treasury metadata.

tools.name: policy_gate
tools.description: Apply treasury policy to a proposed action and return allow, deny, or allow-with-limits. Checks action against configurable policy packs.

actor.description: Actor metadata for the agent proposing the action.

actor_id.description: Stable actor identifier for the agent or wallet operator.

wallet_address.description: Optional onchain wallet address associated with the acting agent.

action_type.description: The proposed action category, such as transfer, swap, or approve.

policy.description: Policy pack input, including policy_id and any policy-specific override values.

context.description: Optional execution context such as chain state, balances, or treasury metadata.

prompts.name: review_treasury_transfer
prompts.description: Guide an agent through the recommended ActionGate evaluation flow for a treasury transfer.
